rankedLeadSummary: 1. RHR — PULSAÇÃO: Resident Advisor says PULSAÇÃO reworks Brazilian finger-drumming and live-remixing practice with eerie textures and acid whiplashes.
2. Purelink — Stadium Drive: Resident Advisor describes Stadium Drive yawning into life as New Age before collecting itself into broken techno one limb at a time.
3. Yazzus — Human Error Processor: Resident Advisor describes an electro-techno fusion with stuttering vocals and hydraulic effects.
4. Yazzus — Metro City Bay Area: Resident Advisor says Metro City Bay Area mixes ghettotech with hurtling Millsian techno and feels frantic, funky and live.
5. Angus Mills — Yelp: Resident Advisor describes Yelp starting sparse before growing into twitchy, cascading UK-style techno with phased, stuttering vocals.
6. Enayet — Chokkor: Resident Advisor describes Chokkor's drums floating into earshot before slamming down, within buzzing broken techno and juddering rhythms.
7. LA-4A — Panic: Resident Advisor describes Panic's kick-and-hi-hat barrage cohering into electro, repeatedly dissolving into stuttering pileups, then pivoting to acid.
8. Roman Flügel — Smell Flashback: Resident Advisor identifies Smell Flashback as a stuttering drum tool with shuffling percussion and a whistling synth.
9. RHR — SÓ ENVOLVIDO: Resident Advisor describes SÓ ENVOLVIDO fusing rumbling bass with crisp kicks and rattling claps.
